component.name: ChannelGuideItem
component.script:
sub init() m.itemBackground = m.top.findNode("itemBackground") m.itemBackground.opacity = manifestOpacity("guide_item_opacity", 0.8) m.channelTitle = m.top.findNode("channelTitle") m.description = m.top.findNode("description") m.playlistSummary = m.top.findNode("playlistSummary") m.tags = m.top.findNode("tags") m.statusStripe = m.top.findNode("statusStripe") m.top.observeField("itemContent", "onContentChanged") end sub
function manifestOpacity(key as string, fallback as float) as float appInfo = createObject("roAppInfo") text = appInfo.getValue(key) if text = invalid or text = "" then return fallback value = text.toFloat() if value < 0 then return 0 if value > 1 then return 1 return value end function
sub onContentChanged() item = m.top.itemContent if item = invalid then return
m.channelTitle.text = item.title m.description.text = item.description
if item.playlistType = "server-random" countText = "Shuffled playlist" if item.totalNumOfVideos > 0 countText = item.totalNumOfVideos.toStr() + " videos" if item.totalPlaylistInMinutes > 0 countText += " | " + int(item.totalPlaylistInMinutes).toStr() + " min" end if countText += " | Shuffled" end if else countText = item.totalNumOfVideos.toStr() + " videos" if item.totalPlaylistInMinutes > 0 countText += " | " + int(item.totalPlaylistInMinutes).toStr() + " min" end if countText += " | Playing " + (item.currentIndex + 1).toStr() end if m.playlistSummary.text = countText
if item.playlistType = "server-random" detail = "EXPLORE2EXPRESS" else detail = UCase(item.playlistType) end if if item.tagsText <> "" then detail += " | " + item.tagsText if item.channelStatus <> "" then detail += " | " + item.channelStatus m.tags.text = detail
status = LCase(item.channelStatus) if status = "offline" or status = "inactive" or status = "disabled" m.statusStripe.color = "#D94A4A" else m.statusStripe.color = "#36C275" end if end sub
